description: Use when an agent must check that a South Korean business is still operating before paying, contracting or onboarding it (KYB, invoice checks). Input: b_no (1-20 business registration numbers, comma-separated, hyphens ok). Output: JSON per number: status (active, suspended, closed, unregistered), VAT taxpayer type, closure date, tax-type change and e-invoice dates, companyId. Data: National Tax Service, synced every 30 min. Example: ?b_no=1248100998 Price: $0.002 USDC (Base or Solana) via x402.

b_no.description: Business registration numbers (사업자등록번호), 10 digits each, comma-separated (max 20); invalid check digit → 400, not charged

name: kr_business_status
title: Korean business registration status (NTS): active, suspended or closed, VAT type, closure date
